newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNISIAN SPCD H1 PROFITS RISE 5.4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: TUNISIAN SPCD H1 PROFITS RISE 5.4 PCT.

text.p: Tunisian detergents firm Societe des Produits Chimiques Detergents said on Friday that pretax profits rose 5.4 percent during the first half of 1997 to 1.929 million dinars ($1.7 million) from 1.831 million dinars during the same period last year.

Sales were 14.7 million dinars, up by 7.3 percent compared to 13.7 million dinars. Detergents production volume was 13,866 tonnes, up by 5.0 percent from 13,196 tonnes. --Tunis newsroom: 2161-787538 ($ = 1.166 Tunisian Dinars)
